name: Button
purpose: Reusable single-line action button styled from the Desktop and Mobile Button tokens.

api.element: Use a native <button type="button"> for actions; use type="submit" when submitting a form.
api.label: Use visible text content for the button name.
api.icon: Place an existing .icon element inside .button__icon before or after the label, and add .button--with-icon to use the icon-specific horizontal padding token.
api.fullWidth: Add .button--full-width when the action should span its container.

usage: Include button.css. Set data-variant, data-size, and data-density on the native button. See example.html for markup.

dependencies.tokenCss: tokens/tokens.css is not required; it does not currently contain Button tokens. The component maps resolved Button values locally.

loading: Not implemented; the token export defines no loading state or spinner.
accessibility: Use a native button and visible text to provide its accessible name.
The native disabled attribute prevents activation and applies exported disabled colors.
The component does not remove the browser keyboard focus indicator.
Mark decorative icons aria-hidden="true". Icon-only buttons are not included in this API.
scope: This component implements the single-line button token family. The separate button-2rows token family is outside this component API.
colorNote: Button icon-color tokens are exposed through CSS color on .button__icon; existing SVGs with fixed fill or stroke colors retain those colors, consistent with the Icon component.
